Project Overview

Designed with purpose,
made for everyday life

Learn about the planning, character, and everyday experience created for One Victoria.

Amidst the fast-paced streets of Newtown, ONE VICTORIA, a retail & apartment complex stands as a tranquil haven, seamlessly blending luxury residences with cutting-edge retail spaces. Located in the thriving Action Area-1, Newtown, relish in the perfect blend of convenience with excellent connectivity.

Choose more than a home or workplace; choose a lifestyle. With Newtown's vibrant community, cultural richness, and futuristic urban planning, One Victoria emerges as the premier address for those seeking the best in both living and business.

Frequently Asked Questions

Helpful project information

Answers to common questions about the project, its features, and the next steps.

What type of property is One Victoria?+

One Victoria is a residential project by Ruchi Realty in Action Area 1, New Town, Kolkata. Review the overview, amenities, specifications and plans on this page for full project details.

What is the current status of One Victoria?+

One Victoria is currently listed as available for enquiry. Contact the project team to confirm the latest construction, possession and inventory status before making a decision.

Is One Victoria RERA registered?+

Yes. The RERA registration number displayed for One Victoria is WBRERA/P/NOR/2024/001080. Buyers should also verify the registration on the relevant official state RERA portal.

How can I check the current price and availability for One Victoria?+

Submit the enquiry form on this page to receive the latest price, available units or plots, configurations and applicable offers directly from the One Victoria sales team.

Can I schedule a site visit or view plans for One Victoria?+

Yes. Use the enquiry option to schedule a site visit. Available floor plans can be viewed on this page. Brochure details can be requested from the project team.
